```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(forcats)

travel_data <- read.csv("travel_data.csv")
travel_data <- na.omit(travel_data)

head(travel_data)
str(travel_data)
summary(travel_data)
```

## Phase 2: 5 Visualizations

```{r}
# 1. Travel Style
ggplot(travel_data, aes(x = TravelStyle, fill = TravelStyle)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat='count', aes(label=..count..), vjust=-0.5) +
  labs(title = "Travel Style Preference Distribution") +
  theme_minimal()

# 2. Cost Distribution
ggplot(travel_data, aes(x = Cost)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Cost Distribution", x = "Cost (INR)", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. Rating Distribution
ggplot(travel_data, aes(x = factor(Rating), fill = factor(Rating))) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Rating Distribution (1-5)", x = "Rating", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# 4. Cost vs Rating
ggplot(travel_data, aes(x = Cost, y = Rating, color = TravelStyle)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "Cost vs Rating (colored by Travel Style)", x = "Cost (INR)", y = "Rating") +
  theme_minimal()

# 5. Destination Frequency
ggplot(travel_data, aes(x = fct_infreq(Destination))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "tomato") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Destination Frequency", x = "Destination", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
